name: Pricing {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: What to charge, how to package it and when to change it.

commands.name: /pricing
commands.does: Opens the OS and reports the live price book and policy state
commands.returns: the price book version, the floor, and any unevidenced line

commands.name: /pricing-model
commands.does: Chooses the pricing model and names the ones rejected
commands.returns: the model, the fit reason, the rejected alternatives

commands.name: /pricing-package
commands.does: Designs the tier structure and what separates the tiers
commands.returns: tiers, each with a named buyer and a reason to move up

commands.name: /price-evidence
commands.does: Records the willingness to pay evidence behind a number
commands.returns: an evidence record with source and date

commands.name: /price-test
commands.does: Designs and reads a willingness to pay test
commands.returns: a test design, then an observed result

commands.name: /price-book
commands.does: Assembles and versions the price book
commands.returns: a versioned price book, one line per sellable thing

commands.name: /discount-policy
commands.does: Sets the permitted range, the approval ladder and the floor
commands.returns: a discount policy with a floor and a named owner

commands.name: /discount-check
commands.does: Adjudicates a specific discount request against the policy
commands.returns: granted, escalated or refused, with the reason

commands.name: /price-change
commands.does: Plans a price move with its revenue impact
commands.returns: a change plan with effective date and impact estimate

commands.name: /grandfather
commands.does: Decides what happens to existing customers on a changed price
commands.returns: a grandfathering decision, per customer segment

commands.name: /pricing-review
commands.does: Reconciles realised discounts against the stated policy
commands.returns: a variance report per deal and per seller

requires_human_approval_for: publishing any price change, on any line of the price book
approving any discount below the policy floor
the grandfathering decision for existing customers on a changed price
publishing or amending the discount policy or the floor itself
recording a price as a deliberate subsidy below unit economics
the exact text of any customer-facing price communication or published price list
